title: The Best Smart Displays
subtitle: Echo Show and Nest Hub screens for your kitchen, nightstand, and smart home, ranked.
intro: We pulled the smart displays selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: screen size, a built-in smart home hub, and a camera for video calls.
systems_note: Echo displays run Alexa. Google doesn't sell Nest displays on Amazon, so every Nest Hub listing is a reseller or an import; we found none worth recommending.

buyers_guide.a: A display adds a screen for cameras, recipes, calendars, and smart home controls. If you want to see your doorbell camera or control lights by touch, get a display. For music and voice only, a speaker is cheaper.

buyers_guide.q: Can a smart display be my hub?
buyers_guide.a: Some can. Several Echo Show models have a built-in Zigbee hub or Thread border router, and Google's Nest Hub (2nd gen) is a Thread border router and Matter controller. Check the listing if you want it to run your devices.
Most displays have a camera shutter and a microphone off switch. Put one with a camera in a kitchen or office rather than a bedroom if that bothers you.
